[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra I.42 (Samādhipāda) — Tatra śabdārthajñānavikalpaiḥ saṃkīrṇā savitarkā samāpattiḥ | Pages 348-351]

Tatra śabdārthajñānavikalpaiḥ saṃkīrṇā savitarkā samāpattiḥ /I.42/
Tatra śabda-artha-jñāna-vikalpaiḥ saṃkīrṇā savitarkā samāpattiḥ /I.42/

 « Parmi [ces adéquations], celle qui est mêlée des fictions propres aux mots, aux
objets et aux notions est dite adéquation discursive. »
836

Tad yathā gaur iti śabdo gaur ity artho gaur iti jñānam ity avibhāgena vibhaktānām api
grahaṇaṃ dṛṣṭam
837 / Vibhajyamānāś ca–anye śabda-dharmā anye'rtha-dharmā anye
vijñāna
838-dharmā ity eteṣām vibhaktaḥ panthāḥ / Tatra samāpannasya yogino
839 yo gav-ādy-
arthaḥ samādhi-prajñāyāṃ samārūḍhaḥ
840 sa cec chabda-artha-jñāna-vikalpa-anuviddha
upāvartate sā saṃkīrṇā samāpattiḥ savitarkā–ity ucyate /42/
